content:
We are currently keeping a close eye on several iPhone 18 Pro accessories and plan to place our orders before the Friday cutoff, as we will also be using these products ourselves this year. If we had to pick, Apple's AirTag 2 and the newly launched AirPods Pro 3 (or AirPods 5) are undoubtedly the best matches for the iPhone 18 Pro — together with the world-class Polishing Cloth, which is equally worth picking up. This time, however, we want to delve deeper, covering accessories such as chargers, MagSafe car mounts, phone cases, and wallets, and we will introduce them one by one below.

iPhone 18 Pro Accessories

  • Chance — Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter (up to 60W)
  • Ben — Apple TechWoven Case
  • Michael — Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger
  • Arin — Apple iPhone FineWoven MagSafe Wallet
  • Ryan — MagSafe Car Mount (designed specifically for the iPhone 18 Pro)
  • Fernando — Burgundy Picogo Air Ultra-Slim Magnetic Power Bank
  • Simon — Baseus Enercore 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Charger
  • Justin — Satechi 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand
  • Reinette — Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case
  • Other Truly Worth-Recommending Accessories

If you want to charge your newly purchased iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max as quickly as possible, you need a compatible charging adapter. Specifically, you need a charger that supports Adjustable Voltage Supply, and Apple's own product is the best choice on the market. It is compact, folds neatly, and can charge your iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max to 50% in just 15 minutes.

Apple's TechWoven case offers a variety of deep, rich colour options. It looks outstanding and feels first-class, with anodised aluminium buttons that provide solid tactile feedback, and the entire case is made from 100% recycled polyester yarn — which also helps protect the environment.

Anker's lightweight 3-in-1 wireless charger can power three devices simultaneously through a single portable accessory, with the iPhone charging pad supporting Qi2 wireless charging and MagSafe compatibility. When folded, it is compact enough to slip easily into a travel bag — meaning you'll never have to lug a tangle of cables and adapters to a hotel again — or you can place it on a bedside table or desk to neatly manage your entire Apple ecosystem. It is currently on sale on Amazon at nearly 65% off, an all-time low price.

Apple's FineWoven MagSafe Wallet has long been a must-have accessory for Apple fans who favour a minimalist style. It easily holds 3 to 4 cards — be it an ID, a few credit cards, or a hotel key card — making it ideal for those who don't want to carry a bulky wallet every day.

Every time I drive, I hope to find a stable and secure spot for my phone. ESR's MagSafe car mount is my top choice. You can securely magnetically attach your iPhone 18 Pro or an older model to the mount, which clips directly onto the air conditioning vent for added convenience. This MagSafe car mount not only protects your iPhone but also keeps the screen clearly visible, and charging while driving is completely hassle-free.

I've always believed that a truly practical magnetic power bank that can be carried out with your iPhone every day must be thin enough. Baseus has just launched a magnetic power bank that I consider nearly perfect. The Picogo Air is only 0.27 inches thick and weighs just 3.7 ounces. It has a built-in 5,000mAh battery, supports 7.5W wireless charging and 22.5W wired input. The standout feature is its brand-new burgundy colourway, which complements the new iPhone beautifully — this is what an ultra-slim magnetic power bank should look like.

If you travel frequently, you'll know that neatly packing your tech organiser bag is already half the battle won. That's why I've been keeping an eye on multi-functional charging solutions. Baseus's travel charger is a perfect fit — it supports plugs in over 200 countries worldwide and is designed to charge six devices simultaneously. But for me, the biggest highlight is the built-in 70W retractable USB-C cable, which can fast-charge your iPhone 18 Pro at full speed while steadily powering your iPad, MacBook, and other devices.

Michael previously picked out what I consider the best foldable MagSafe charger for travel, but this time I want to focus on my two favourite desktop 3-in-1 charging stands: the Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, whose design is absolutely stunning, paired with an ultra-minimalist space-grey black finish; and the Anker Smart Display 3-in-1, which I also love — but the Satechi is truly so elegant and refined that it's beyond compare.

After spending a fortune on the iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, I usually opt for more affordable accessories rather than splurging on the most expensive products all over again. Spigen offers a wide range of reasonably priced MagSafe cases. My personal favourite is this clear Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case, which is far cheaper than other brands — there are also opaque multi-colour options, all supporting MagSafe fast wireless charging. These cases incorporate DuraClear blue resin into the TPU frame to prevent yellowing, paired with a shock-absorbing structure; notably, the Camera Control button surface is also coated with a thin layer of TPU.

  • AirTag 2
  • Anker 100W USB-C Smart Display Charger
  • Beats Woven USB-C Cable
  • Brand-new Pitaka Burgundy Aramid Fibre iPhone 18 Pro Protective Case
  • Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Leather Protective Case
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Resistant Protective Case
  • Twelve South Butterfly 2-in-1
  • Nomad Find My Tracker Card
